correctness.rationale: The fundamental-chamber reduction partitions all nonzero normals into 15 exact root-sign patterns. The included Z[φ] checker enumerates all 120 roots, 720 edges, 1200 triangular ridges and 600 tetrahedral facets, then exact section incidences. Eleven distinct inventories are found; every one of the 15 rows satisfies V−E+F=2 and 3T+4Q=2E. Independently triangulated numerical 3D hulls agree in all fifteen cases. Exact enumeration plus proven Coxeter symmetry, not Monte Carlo, establishes exhaustiveness.

originality.rationale: Actual searches and comparisons across H4 root systems, 600-cell section terminology, published polytope-section results and retained claim overlap found no complete 15-stratum/11-inventory theorem. The newest claim is not implied by the closest papers or previously retained invariants. Historical priority remains provisional because Coxeter’s original Table V was not fully accessible.
residual_risks: An older table in Coxeter or other regular-polytope literature may encode some special central sections or a complete equivalent census. Primary Table V was not inspected in full.

Historical priority and external independent scientific validation remain open.

value.rationale: A natural complete section-inventory classification of the exceptional H4 regular 600-cell across all central directions, including reflection-mirror strata, answers a concrete geometric question; it yields sharp extremal vertex counts 42 and 144 and generic rigidity, and distinguishes same-vertex-count sections by edge and facet incidence. These motivated full-family invariants are not merely a coordinate normalization or known-table recomputation.
